bpmn:participant.name: BPMN-23 | Low-Stock Monitoring and Product Availability Control

bpmn:process.name: Low-Stock Monitoring and Product Availability Control
bpmn:process.bpmn:documentation: Sources: docs/proposed-bpmn-catalog.md (all 43 scopes and reuse rules); Chapters/Kitchen406 - Capstone Paper.md SRS 4.12 FR-INV-10�12,20, supporting FR-INV-19, FR-NOTIF-08�10 and BR-15; index.html and linked app/inventory-state.js I.available/I.status/I.reason, app/staff-state.js S.checkStockAlerts/S.emit and owner/staff inventory interfaces. Existing bounded XML 01�07,22�26 and broad inventory-control/order-checkout reviewed. The broad inventory-control predecessor contains monitoring but also unrelated maintenance and reservation retry, so it is not invoked. BPMN-20/21 supply post-change signals; BPMN-25 independently owns internal notifications; BPMN-09 independently combines ingredient and capacity validation before payment. BPMN-11 shortage retry, BPMN-20 restocking and BPMN-21 adjustments are separate work, not automatically invoked. Reuse uses an asynchronous signal handoff rather than a synchronous call to notification creation/read acknowledgment. No unresolved calledElement references or placeholder executable processes. No existing XML changed. Alternative stock-change and request starts merge exclusively; each instance evaluates the current affected set, including restored availability. One pool with vertical Admin/Owner or authorized Staff and Inventory Management lanes; internal sequence flows are appropriate, with no artificial message flow between lanes. Signals represent internal independently triggered work; no external participant. No automatic purchasing, paid-order cancellation, reservation changes, capacity booking or provider email/SMS assumption. Proposed SRS takes precedence over prototype recipient roles. Non-executable descriptive model, top to bottom.

bpmn:userTask.name: Request current stock evaluation
bpmn:userTask.bpmn:documentation: Authenticated Admin/Owner or authorized Staff; BPMN-26 supplies the authentication precondition. No timer interval or threshold configuration workflow is invented.

bpmn:startEvent.name: Ingredient stock changed
bpmn:startEvent.bpmn:documentation: Catch the post-change signal used by BPMN-11, BPMN-20 and BPMN-21. Also evaluate after consumption or release changes available stock. Separate files use local signal IDs; the descriptive signal name is the shared contract.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Read current stock, reservations, thresholds and required-ingredient mappings
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Read latest recorded physical stock and active reservations in compatible ingredient units. Available = physical minus reserved. Read configured low-stock thresholds and existing recipe/BoM dependencies, not planning demand as another reservation. Refer to BPMN-35 for recipe maintenance; do not modify recipes here.

bpmn:businessRuleTask.name: Check thresholds and one-unit ingredient requirements
bpmn:businessRuleTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-10�12,20; BR-15. Evaluate all affected ingredients/products, not only one arbitrary ingredient. At/below threshold is low, including zero; above threshold is normal. For each affected variant, compare available stock with the recipe quantities for one unit. Block new orders for variants that fall short, including when an ingredient is depleted. BPMN-09 checks the quantities requested and combined ingredient needs of the purchase. For a due paid subscription in BPMN-11, stock at or below the threshold is still eligible for reservation when the required quantities are available. Publish any new low-stock alert independently of the reservation. Depletion after a successful reservation can affect new orders while the saved reservation remains valid. Prototype I.available/I.status/I.reason supplies the available-stock interpretation. Do not confuse physical consumption with reservations.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: New low-stock alert needed?
bpmn:exclusiveGateway.bpmn:documentation: Compare current low state with previous evaluation. Emit once per ingredient low-stock episode, as in S.checkStockAlerts; another evaluation in the same episode must not duplicate alerts. Returning above threshold resets the episode for a future low transition.

bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.name: Refer to BPMN-25 � Internal Notification Creation and Read Acknowledgment
bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent.bpmn:documentation: Publish a role-targeted low-stock notification event for Admin/Owner with ingredient reference, stock and threshold context. BPMN-25 separately owns creation and per-account read state. Asynchronous signal handoff; this process never waits for reading or external delivery. The prototype targets operational staff; proposed owner recipient follows FR-INV-11. Brevo/Semaphore owner alerts are not required by the SRS.

bpmn:exclusiveGateway.name: Can stock cover one unit of each affected variant?

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Block variants with shortages and refresh other variants
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: FR-INV-12. Block new orders for each variant that lacks enough ingredients for one unit. Refresh stock eligibility for the other evaluated variants. Preserve existing paid orders and ingredient commitments; do not cancel orders, release reservations, or start shortage recovery.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Refresh ingredient eligibility; remove resolved stock blocks
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Remove the stock restriction for each variant once all ingredients required for one unit are available. Replenishment alone does not override catalog availability, recipe completeness, requested quantities, scheduling or capacity. Do not force all products to Available.

bpmn:serviceTask.name: Publish stock state and ingredient ordering restrictions
bpmn:serviceTask.bpmn:documentation: Save latest evaluation and low-stock episode state consistently; availability reflects current stock, not a stale earlier evaluation. Repeated evaluations do not create stock movements. FR-INV-20: provide ingredient eligibility to purchasing; Refer to BPMN-09 � Ingredient and Capacity Validation and Purchase Reservation for combined order-specific inventory/capacity validation. No capacity allocation is performed here. Notification delivery does not gate availability control.

bpmn:endEvent.name: Alerts triggered as needed; ordering availability updated

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: Yes
bpmn:sequenceFlow.bpmn:conditionExpression: At least one ingredient has entered a new at-or-below-threshold episode.

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: No
bpmn:sequenceFlow.bpmn:conditionExpression: At least one affected variant lacks enough available stock to make one unit.

bpmn:sequenceFlow.name: Yes
bpmn:sequenceFlow.bpmn:conditionExpression: Available stock covers every required ingredient for one unit of each affected variant.
